`0.html` was a single line with only a doctype and a `<title>`. I've made it a complete, standard HTML5 page:

- **`<html lang="en">`**: tells screen readers, search engines and translation tools what language the page is in.
- **`<meta charset="utf-8">`**: makes the browser read the text correctly instead of guessing.
- **Viewport meta tag**: makes the page display at the right size on phones.
- **`<head>` and `<body>`**: written out in full with indentation so it's easier to add to later.
